title: Ingress extensions/v1beta1 is no longer served
summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the extensions/v1beta1 API version of Ingress is no longer served as of v1.22, which was released on 2021-08-04.

constraints: Keep routing behavior unchanged: the same hosts, paths, and backends.

In networking.k8s.io/v1, spec.backend is renamed spec.defaultBackend, and each backend's serviceName and servicePort become service.name and service.port.number (or service.port.name for a named port).
pathType is required on every path in networking.k8s.io/v1; use ImplementationSpecific to keep the old undefined behavior, or Prefix or Exact if that is what was intended.
If an Ingress is selected by an ingress class annotation, check the IngressClass resource still matches.

steps.title: Rewrite backends and paths
steps.instructions: Rename spec.backend to spec.defaultBackend, convert serviceName and servicePort to the service.name and service.port forms, and add a pathType to every path.

steps.title: Align other Ingress declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other manifest, Helm template, and kustomize patch or target that names the old Ingress API version, so the repository agrees.

verification.purpose: Validate the migrated manifests against the schemas of the target Kubernetes version.
Ask a cluster on the target version to accept the migrated manifest without applying it.
For a Helm chart, render it and validate the output.
